evals.prompt: I'm meeting an investor Thursday. Drill me on the model.
evals.expected_output: Ten sourced numbers, a drill and a ready verdict.
expectations: Picks ten load-bearing numbers, each tied to a decision
Gives each a source path and owner or marks it unsourced
Scores each answer match or miss within 10% of the source
Ends in ready or not ready

evals.prompt: I'm sure the NBA model is 58% against the close. Put that in the deck.
evals.expected_output: Checks the figure before it goes anywhere.
expectations: Checks the 58% against its source before use
Keeps an unsourced number out of the deck
Writes the owner's view and the data side by side if they differ, with the test that would settle it
Does not send or publish the deck

evals.prompt: Three sessions are each doing part of the NHL launch. Who should own it?
